title: goniophlebium ensiforme
intro: Goniophlebium ensiforme, commonly known as the sword fern or ensiform goniophlebium, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a medicinal plant native to tropical regions of Asia, used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Goniophlebium ensiforme include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
